headline.en: KKR launches equipment finance firm with $350 million
headline.zh: KKR以3.5亿美元成立设备融资公司

summary.en: KKR has launched an equipment finance firm with $350 million. No further details were provided in the report.
summary.zh: KKR以3.5亿美元成立了一家设备融资公司。报道未提供更多细节。

headline.en: KKR launches a lender for small businesses buying work equipment
headline.zh: KKR 推出一家面向购买作业设备的小型企业的贷款机构

summary.en: KKR launched a lender for small businesses buying work equipment, according to Stock Titan. The report provided no further details on the size, structure or funding of the business.
summary.zh: 据 Stock Titan 报道，KKR 推出一家面向购买作业设备的小型企业的贷款机构。该报道未提供有关该业务的规模、结构或资金的进一步细节。

headline.en: KKR launches equipment finance platform Akrapoint Commercial Capital
headline.zh: KKR 推出设备融资平台 Akrapoint Commercial Capital

summary.en: KKR launched an equipment finance platform called Akrapoint Commercial Capital, according to Business Wire. No financial terms or leadership details were disclosed.
summary.zh: 据 Business Wire 报道，KKR 推出了名为 Akrapoint Commercial Capital 的设备融资平台。报道未披露财务条款或管理层细节。

headline.en: Australian regulator cracks down on three private credit products
headline.zh: 澳大利亚监管机构打击三款私人信贷产品

summary.en: Australia's regulator has cracked down on three private credit products, according to Alternative Credit Investor. The report gives no further details on the products, the managers involved or the remedies imposed.
summary.zh: 据Alternative Credit Investor报道，澳大利亚监管机构已对三款私人信贷产品采取打击行动。报道未提供有关这些产品、涉及的资产管理公司或所采取措施的进一步细节。

headline.en: Australian regulator bans three private credit products from Melbourne Securities
headline.zh: 澳大利亚监管机构禁止Melbourne Securities的三款私人信贷产品

summary.en: Australia's corporate regulator, ASIC, temporarily banned three private credit products offered by Melbourne Securities Corporation, the products being offered under the Remara Cash Management Fund. ASIC said it issued stop orders and put the industry on notice.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚企业监管机构ASIC暂时禁止了Melbourne Securities Corporation提供的三款私人信贷产品，这些产品在Remara Cash Management Fund下发行。ASIC表示已发出停止令，并向该行业发出警告。

headline.en: KKR commits $350m to launch equipment finance platform Akrapoint
headline.zh: KKR承诺3.5亿美元推出设备融资平台Akrapoint

summary.en: KKR has committed $350m to launch Akrapoint, an equipment finance platform, pehub.com reported.
summary.zh: 据pehub.com报道，KKR已承诺3.5亿美元推出设备融资平台Akrapoint。

headline.en: Australia's ASIC flags poor practices in private credit
headline.zh: 澳大利亚公司监管机构点名私募信贷领域的“不良做法”

summary.en: Australia's corporate regulator called out poor practices in private credit, according to a report by The Edge Malaysia. The report did not name specific managers or funds.
summary.zh: 据《The Edge Malaysia》报道，澳大利亚公司监管机构点名私募信贷领域的“不良做法”。报道未提及具体的管理人或基金。

headline.en: Australia's corporate regulator calls out 'poor practices' in private credit
headline.zh: 澳大利亚公司监管机构指出私人信贷领域存在"不良做法"

summary.en: Australia's corporate regulator has called out 'poor practices' in private credit, according to the report headline.
summary.zh: 据报道标题，澳大利亚公司监管机构指出私人信贷领域存在"不良做法"。

headline.en: Neuberger Specialty Finance launches Bridge AeroFinance to build over $2 billion aerospace credit portfolio
headline.zh: Neuberger Specialty Finance 推出 Bridge AeroFinance，拟建立超20亿美元航空航天信贷组合

summary.en: Neuberger Specialty Finance launched a new platform, Bridge AeroFinance, to build an aerospace credit portfolio of more than $2 billion.
summary.zh: Neuberger Specialty Finance 推出了新平台 Bridge AeroFinance，旨在建立规模超过20亿美元的航空航天信贷组合。

headline.en: Australian regulator warns private credit firms of more enforcement after Bathla insolvency
headline.zh: 澳大利亚监管机构在Bathla破产后警告私人信贷公司将有更多执法行动

summary.en: Australia's regulator warned private credit firms of further enforcement action following the Bathla insolvency. The article provides no additional details on the firms involved or the figures.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚监管机构在Bathla破产后警告私人信贷公司将有进一步执法行动。文章未提供有关涉事公司或具体数字的更多细节。

headline.en: QIA and J.P. Morgan Asset Management form $20 billion partnership across global equities and U.S. private credit
headline.zh: QIA与J.P. Morgan Asset Management组建200亿美元合作伙伴关系，覆盖全球股票和美国私人信贷

summary.en: QIA and J.P. Morgan Asset Management formed a $20 billion partnership covering global equities and U.S. private credit. The article gives no further details on the structure or terms.
summary.zh: QIA与J.P. Morgan Asset Management组建了一项200亿美元的合作伙伴关系，覆盖全球股票和美国私人信贷。文章未提供有关结构或条款的更多细节。

headline.en: Lincoln Financial Boosts Stake in Lincoln Bain Capital Total Credit Fund to 72.21%
headline.zh: Lincoln Financial 将 Lincoln Bain Capital Total Credit Fund 持股比例提高至 72.21%

summary.en: Lincoln Financial boosted its stake in the Lincoln Bain Capital Total Credit Fund to 72.21% under an activist 13D filing. The filing was dated September 22, 2026.
summary.zh: 根据一份维权的 13D 文件，Lincoln Financial 将其在 Lincoln Bain Capital Total Credit Fund 的持股比例提高至 72.21%。该文件日期为 2026 年 9 月 22 日。

headline.en: Boston Retirement commits $80 million to private credit
headline.zh: Boston Retirement向私人信贷承诺8000万美元

summary.en: Boston Retirement committed $80 million to private credit, according to Pensions & Investments. No manager or fund was named in the available report.
summary.zh: 据Pensions & Investments报道，Boston Retirement向私人信贷承诺了8000万美元。现有报道未披露具体管理人及基金名称。

headline.en: Tether and Fasanara Capital launch $3B stablecoin-powered private credit fund
headline.zh: Tether与Fasanara Capital推出30亿美元稳定币驱动的私人信贷基金

summary.en: Tether and Fasanara Capital have launched a $3 billion private credit fund powered by stablecoins, according to connectmoney.com. No further details on strategy, structure or investors were provided in the report.
summary.zh: 据connectmoney.com报道，Tether与Fasanara Capital推出了一只规模30亿美元、由稳定币驱动的私人信贷基金。报道未提供有关策略、结构或投资者的更多细节。
